### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">In the three high-burden areas, G6PD testing will be rolled out with high dose 7-day PQ. G6PD normal will receive the &quot;optimal&quot; dose, intermediates will received 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days, deficient provided 8 week. Follow up of patients will remain the same</div>
